source_title: The Legend of the Condor Heroes
continuity_scope: Jin Yong (金庸), A Hero Born: Legends of the Condor Heroes, Volume 1, Anna Holmwood's licensed English translation, St. Martin's Griffin definitive edition, ISBN 9781250220622, 432 pp. Scope is limited further to the authorized Chapter One opening through the Ox Village tavern scene on the publisher page. No Chinese revision/serialization comparison, later volume, screen/comic/game adaptation, or unofficial translation is used.

work_or_witnesses.edition: St. Martin's Griffin, Anna Holmwood translation, definitive edition, ISBN 9781250220622, 432 pages.

coverage_rule: Include only the four individually named dramatic people in the authorized Chapter One opening/Ox Village tavern segment: Skyfury Guo, Ironheart Yang, Old Zhang, and Qu San. This is not a full-volume or full-novel character audit; all later names and any person outside that exact excerpt segment are omitted.
omissions: All characters introduced after the authorized Chapter One opening/Ox Village tavern segment, including Guo Jing and later central figures.
All later translated volumes, Chinese serial and revision variants, television/film/comic/game adaptations, and unofficial translations.
Martial schools, clans, techniques, titles, weapons, locations, the Song/Jin historical framing, and wuxia as character nodes.
uncertainties: English names such as Skyfury Guo and Ironheart Yang are Anna Holmwood translation forms; no claim is made that they are the only Chinese-script/pinyin localizations.
The excerpt is a licensed translation witness, not a substitute for a full Chinese textual-critical edition. It supports only the declared opening segment.

The novel's fictional martial artistry and altered historical frame are not claims about real Chinese martial traditions or history. The opening contains invasion, killing, coercion, suicide, and war references; records stay non-graphic.
evidence_basis: The publisher's authorized Chapter One excerpt directly supplies the exact opening segment, translated names, setting, and the Guo–Yang sworn-brother relation. Macmillan's product metadata establishes the licensed Holmwood volume and its one-volume boundary. No fan source is used.

citations.locator: Authorized Chapter One, ‘Suddenly a Snow Storm,’ opening through Ox Village tavern scene; Book Details
supports: Translation/edition, Skyfury Guo, Ironheart Yang, Old Zhang, Qu San, Song/Jin setting, and direct sworn-brother relation.
